shared_elements: carved relief decoration on an architectural stone surface
justification: A depicts a standing nude human figure carved in high relief against a pillar-like slab within an architectural setting, while B depicts nothing but non-figural ornament: registers of rosettes, a palmette frieze and a row of interlocking scale/braid motifs. The only correspondence is the generic fact of relief carving on architecture and a loose sense of banded/framed surfaces; there is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and no shared figural convention.
